bestPractices.title: 'Code-to-Cloud': Industry Mentored Project Ecosystem
bestPractices.objectives: To bridge academia-industry disparity through continuous multi-semester project development guided by corporate mentors.
bestPractices.context: Traditional academic projects often lack industry architectural standards and version control rigor.
bestPractices.practice: Every UG and PG final-year team is paired with an industry alumnus / mentor. Code is managed through GitHub Classroom, CI/CD pipelines, and evaluated by external architects.
bestPractices.evidence: 118 students secured direct internships and pre-placement offers (PPOs) at Tier-1 IT companies.
bestPractices.resourcesRequired: Cloud credits, GitHub Education campus package, dedicated corporate mentor coordination cell.

bestPractices.title: 360° Remedial & Peer-Assisted Learning (PAL)
bestPractices.objectives: To eliminate backlogs in core algorithmic courses and uplift first-generation collegiate learners.
bestPractices.context: Diverse socio-economic student background leads to varied entry-level programming aptitudes.
bestPractices.practice: Diagnostic assessment at week 3; slow learners paired with high-performing student mentors (PAL) along with 30 hours of evening hands-on coding clinics.
bestPractices.evidence: Semester pass percentage in Data Structures and Java increased from 74% to 94.2%. Backlogs dropped by 68%.
bestPractices.resourcesRequired: Student mentor stipends from college seed funds, extended lab hours, customized bilingual course notes.
